'''Can Giouc''' was a [[cargo ferry]] [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] forces used during the [[Sepan Civil War]].

During the near end of the [[Sepan campaign]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|Escort Carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]'' delivered a consignment of [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s flagship, the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory-I'' class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']], near [[Gerbaud 2]].

The Dimoks, as part of a joint Dimok/[[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] assault force intending to disrupt the transfer of the [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighters]] sent multiple ships to attack the Protector and Troposbor. The ''Can Giouc'', along with [[Suoi Tre]] both arrived to attack the Protector.

[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele's]] heroic performance saved the TIE Avengers, and the Cargo Ferries were likely destroyed in the battle.
